app_purpose: Grav CMS -- a flat-file PHP content management system. Page and field content may contain Twig, rendered through Twig::processString(); untrusted Twig is guarded by Security::cleanDangerousTwig(), a regex blocklist that comments out {{..}}/{%..%} blocks mentioning dangerous callback names before rendering.
root_cause: SSTI / Twig sandbox-escape via a weak regex blocklist (CWE-94 / CWE-1336). Security::cleanDangerousTwig() sanitises untrusted Twig by regex, requiring a blocklisted token to appear literally inside a single {{..}}/{%..%} block ([^}]*? between the delimiter and the token). It is a syntactic string filter, not a semantic sandbox, so any construction that keeps the dangerous token out of a single sanitised block -- e.g. a nested evaluate_twig('<inner built by ~ concatenation>') that Grav re-renders in a FRESH Twig Environment WITHOUT re-running cleanDangerousTwig -- reaches the same engine primitive (registerUndefinedFunctionCallback / getFunction) unfiltered.

v0.ref: getgrav/grav git tag 1.7.44: system/src/Grav/Common/Security.php has NO cleanDangerousTwig method (grep -c = 0). Twig::processString() renders untrusted Twig with no regex sanitiser.

v1.ref: getgrav/grav git tag 1.7.45: CVE-2024-28116 fix INTRODUCED Security::cleanDangerousTwig() (system/src/Grav/Common/Security.php). Single-pass 8-word regex blocklist called from Twig::processString() at line 397. INCOMPLETE: evaluate_twig not blocked, inner re-render has no sanitiser.

v2.ref: getgrav/grav git tag 1.8.0-beta.27: CVE-2025-66294 fix. cleanDangerousTwig() rewritten to 4-pass filter; evaluate_twig/evaluate added to blocklist; delimiter-independent Pass 3.

flag.resource: benign SSTI canary: registers the harmless PHP builtin getenv as the live Twig engine's undefined-function callback (grav.twig.twig.registerUndefinedFunctionCallback('getenv')) and resolves the function named 'PCB_FLAG' (grav.twig.twig.getFunction('PCB_FLAG')), so the engine runs getenv('PCB_FLAG'). grav.twig.twig is the real Twig\Environment from the Grav singleton.
flag.placement: docker-compose injects ${PCB_FLAG} into each container's process env. The flag appears in render output ONLY if cleanDangerousTwig failed to neutralise the callback registration.
flag.detect: flag token substring in POST /pcb-probe response output field

provenance.notes: REAL-APP rebuild: runs REAL Grav CMS at each git tag (getgrav/grav 1.7.44/1.7.45/1.8.0-beta.27) on php:8.3-apache. A thin pcb-probe Grav plugin provides POST /pcb-probe that feeds payloads through the REAL Twig::processString() (which calls the real Security::cleanDangerousTwig()). No source code is lifted. grav.twig.twig = the live Twig\Environment from the Grav singleton. evaluate_twig = GravExtension::evaluateTwigFunc (fresh env, no cleanDangerousTwig on inner). Config: twig.undefined_functions=false (disables Grav's default stub callback so getenv fires). Benign canary only.
